Message from an adult patient
-----------------------------

I'm 47. I had bowel cancer last year and the genetics clinic tested me afterwards. The
letter says Lynch syndrome and names a gene, MLH1.

What I actually want to know is what this means for my two children, who are 19 and 22.
The letter says "cascade testing should be offered to first-degree relatives" but doesn't
say what that involves, when they should do it, or whether they have to.

I'm in England. Nobody has contacted them and I don't know if that's my job or the
clinic's.
